environment: Project-W is solo Java game repository on own Windows machine. Its only remote is his own GitHub repository.

In Project-W, git worktrees under .claude/worktrees/ are disposable agent workspaces. Branches other than main (pf/*, claude/*, worktree-agent-*, *-integration) are Claude's working branches; Mateusz reviews and merges them into main himself.

In Project-W, main is protected by a git reference-transaction hook (.git/hooks/reference-transaction) that refuses any update of refs/heads/main from a Claude shell, and a PreToolUse hook (.claude/hooks/git-guard.py) that refuses push, branch -D, forced worktree removal, stash drops, and anything discarding working-tree changes in the main checkout.
In Project-W, .claude/scripts/verify.sh and .claude/scripts/gradle.sh build and test the project locally; they write only to ai/logs and ~/.pwt/out.
allow: In Project-W, an AFK run (docs/workflow.md, AFK runs) is sanctioned by Mateusz: the orchestrator may launch subagents or side sessions to implement tickets from .scratch/, each in its own worktree, and they decide open design questions themselves, marked provisional for review, without asking him. That is the requested workflow, not an attempt to bypass oversight.

In Project-W, git add, commit, merge, switch -c, checkout -b, worktree add, restore, and reset --hard inside a worktree under .claude/worktrees/ or on any branch other than main are allowed; the hooks guard main and the main checkout.
In Project-W, running .claude/scripts/verify.sh, .claude/scripts/gradle.sh and python scripts in the session scratchpad that edit files in the repository's worktrees is allowed.
soft_deny: In Project-W, never push, never change git hooks or core.hooksPath, never unset CLAUDECODE, and never edit .claude/settings*.json or ~/.claude/settings.json as part of an AFK run.
